newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Companion to raise HK$53 mln in shr issue.
newsitem.headline: Companion to raise HK$53 mln in shr issue.

text.p: Companion Building Material (Holdings) Ltd said it had agreed to issue 38 million new shares at HK$1.42 per share to Shiu & Leung Enterprises Ltd, raising net proceeds of about HK$53.15 million.
It said Shiu & Leung has also agreed to place 38 million existing shares, or 5.63 percent of Companion's existing issued share capital, at HK$1.42 per share to professional investors.
Companion Building said about HK$20 million of the net proceeds would be used to reduce bank borrowings and the balance would be used to expand production capacity.

"The directors consider that it is appropriate to strengthen the financial base of the company and its subsidiaries by the subscription so as to enable the company to capitalise on suitable investment opportunities when they arise," Companion Building added.
The new shares represent 5.33 percent of the enlarged share capital of the company.

After the subscription and placement, Shiu & Leung, and parties acting in concert with it, will own 274.66 million shares, or 38.49 percent of the enlarged issued share capital, compared with 40.66 percent of the existing issued share capital before the transactions.
